from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/core.py').resolve()

 module = importlib.import_module('apispec.core')

 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:

   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')

 raise

assert spec.components.schemas['Now'] is component

reference=spec.components.get_ref('schema','Later')
